elements.text: Product questions What backup rating does GW5K-ETA-G20 have?The AC side backup port of the GW5K-ETA-G20 has a rated apparent power of 5 kVA. How many MPPTs does GW5K-ETA-G20 have?The GW5K-ETA-G20 has 3 MPPTs. Which battery modules stack with this power module?The manual lists the battery modules GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20, and states that battery modules of different models can be mixed. For stacking, the manual gives these limits: GW5.1-BAT-D-G20 and GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 up to 3 batteries, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20 and GW8.3-BAT-D-G21 up to 2 batteries, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 up to 3 batteries, GW9.0-BAT-D-G20 up to 2 batteries. When GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 and GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 are mixed and stacked, each system group supports up to 3 batteries. For floor installation, up to 4 batteries can be stacked away from the wall and up to 6 batteries against the wall.
